artifact_observations.location: Grip pattern on the lower body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid/checkered texture on the lower half appears slightly irregular and 'mushy' rather than having sharp, uniform mechanical precision. Some lines fade or merge inconsistently, suggesting AI generation artifacts in fine repetitive patterns.
The connection between the spark wheel and the main body lacks clear mechanical definition. The axle area is somewhat blurred and indistinct, making the physical attachment point ambiguous.
The geometry of the top metal shield is slightly asymmetrical and warped. The right side appears thicker and less defined than the left, deviating from the expected symmetry of a manufactured part.
